## Summary of Receiver Types

- **`*SSEHub`** (package `v1`, file `sse_hub.go`) -- Disconnects all subscribed SSE clients. Returns nothing.
- **`*Store`** (package `store`, file `store.go`) -- Stops all cache cleanup goroutines and closes the underlying driver. Returns `error`.
- **`*Cache`** (package `cache`, file `cache.go`) -- Stops the cache cleanup goroutine. Returns `error`. Implements the `cache.Interface` interface.
- **`*MemoFilterTestContext`** (package `test`, file `filter_helpers_test.go`) -- Test helper; delegates to `Store.Close()`. Returns nothing.
- **`*AttachmentFilterTestContext`** (package `test`, file `filter_helpers_test.go`) -- Test helper; delegates to `Store.Close()`. Returns nothing.
- **`*DB`** (package `sqlite`, file `sqlite.go`) -- Closes the underlying `*sql.DB`. Returns `error`. Implements the `store.Driver` interface.
- **`*DB`** (package `postgres`, file `postgres.go`) -- Closes the underlying `*sql.DB`. Returns `error`. Implements the `store.Driver` interface.
- **`*DB`** (package `mysql`, file `mysql.go`) -- Closes the underlying `*sql.DB`. Returns `error`. Implements the `store.Driver` interface.

There are no standalone `func Close(...)` declarations (non-method) anywhere in the repository. All `Close` declarations are methods on a receiver type, plus the two interface contracts listed above.
